definition: The process of selecting, filtering, cleaning, and organizing data to improve its quality and suitability for training or evaluation.
details: Data curation has become increasingly recognized as a critical lever for model quality, sometimes rivaling model architecture and scale in its impact on final performance.
story: Think of a historian sorting through boxes of letters, building a picture of an era one sentence at a time. Every machine is shaped by what it was shown, so someone has to choose that material with care. The examples a machine reads become the world it believes in. The words a model reads become the world it believes in. And that is Data Curation — the unglamorous work everything else stands on.
